source_findings.evidence: No added semantic tuple has a CaptureDetailPage or VideoErrorFeedbackDialog site. The proven TLVideoCompleteView listeners still pass selector 3/4, not 107/1021.
The new sites are YSP/DtX5 inherited operations and removals, but ShellActivity remains an uncertain host. A longer report path does not close its lifecycle execution and concrete player binding.

The source-owned YspMediaPlayer$attachTo$1 or PendantWebView already existed for these hosts. New facts are inherited X5/DtX5 operations and constructor removals on that receiver. Rows typed only as DtX5WebView/BaseWebView are polymorphic aliases, not distinct new WebViews.

Each login flow reaches Tencent/QQAuth and AuthDialog with the Activity. AuthDialog.d creates/configures its com.tencent.open.d.d WebView, installs both clients, applies the settings, and loads it. LoginWithBackground restores the full same-object group; sibling additions are inherited operations on that object.

WebViewForCell and page-manager operations are source-reachable, but nine additions retain top-level unknown receiver type and three YSP superclass operations lack a newly proven same-object binding. They cannot all be accepted from path length alone.

Their tab fragments can create the video container and YSP object. The additions include valid inherited operations on YspMediaPlayer$attachTo$1, plus duplicate DtX5WebView aliases and mutually exclusive android.webkit/com.tencent.smtt helper branches. Host ownership remains valid, while not every added row is a distinct valid capability.
